title: AI Agent Guide
subtitle: 通过交互实验理解 LLM、Agent 与 RAG 的核心工程机制
subtitleEn: An interactive engineering guide to LLMs, Agents, and RAG

parts.name: 导览 · 全局坐标与术语

chapters.title: AI Agent 工程全景图
chapters.summary: 通过一次完整任务说明 LLM、上下文、工具、记忆、RAG 与 Harness 的协作关系，并提供术语速查与易混概念对照
chapters.summaryEn: End-to-end walkthrough of LLM, context, tools, memory, RAG, and harness collaboration with a quick glossary

parts.name: 模块一 · LLM 工程基础

chapters.title: Prompt Engineering
chapters.titleEn: Prompt Engineering: From Asking to Constraining
chapters.summary: 讲清模型调用、采样参数、任务约束与 Few-shot，理解 Prompt 能解决什么、不能解决什么
chapters.summaryEn: Model calls, sampling parameters, task constraints, Few-shot, and Prompt boundaries

chapters.title: 结构化输出与结果校验
chapters.summary: 使用 JSON Schema 与 Zod 建立输出契约，处理格式错误、业务校验失败与有限重试
chapters.summaryEn: Enforcing output contracts with JSON Schema and Zod, handling format/business errors and retries

chapters.title: Context Engineering
chapters.titleEn: Context Engineering: Why More Context Hurts
chapters.summary: 理解上下文来源、信息位置与预算，通过筛选、组织和按需加载提高有效信息比例
chapters.summaryEn: Context sources, information placement, token budgets, and Just-In-Time loading

chapters.title: Prompt 回归评测
chapters.summary: 建立用例集、评分规则与版本门禁，验证 Prompt、模型和参数改动是否带来退步
chapters.summaryEn: Evaluation suites, scoring rules, and version gates to catch regressions

parts.name: 模块二 · Agent 核心机制

chapters.title: Tool Calling 与 Mini Agent Loop
chapters.titleEn: Tool Calling & the Mini Agent Loop
chapters.summary: 从工具声明、参数校验、执行分发到结果回传，逐步实现一个具有停止条件的最小 Agent
chapters.summaryEn: Tool declarations, schema validation, dispatch, and stopping conditions for a minimal Agent

chapters.title: Workflow 与 Agent 的架构选择
chapters.summary: 比较顺序、路由、并行和动态循环，判断哪些步骤交给代码、哪些交给模型
chapters.summaryEn: Comparing chaining, routing, parallelization, and dynamic loops to decide code vs. model control

chapters.title: 任务规划与反馈修正
chapters.summary: 实现任务拆解、计划执行与动态调整，利用测试和工具反馈修正结果，并验证收益
chapters.summaryEn: Task decomposition, dynamic replanning, and self-correction using tests and tool feedback

chapters.title: Harness 与执行边界
chapters.summary: 通过权限校验、人工审批、执行隔离和资源预算，控制 Agent 可以做什么以及何时必须停止
chapters.summaryEn: Permission checks, human-in-the-loop approval, isolation, and resource budgets

chapters.title: 记忆管理与上下文压缩
chapters.summary: 区分工作记忆与长期记忆，处理信息的写入、检索、更新、遗忘及历史压缩
chapters.summaryEn: Working vs. long-term memory, write/retrieve/update/forget flows, and history compaction

chapters.title: 任务状态与中断恢复
chapters.summary: 使用检查点、操作记录和幂等机制，处理超时、重试、进程中断及重复执行
chapters.summaryEn: Checkpoints, execution logs, and idempotency for timeouts, retries, and crash recovery

chapters.title: 流式交互与执行状态展示
chapters.summary: 将文本生成、工具执行和审批事件映射到界面，处理取消、断线与恢复后的状态同步
chapters.summaryEn: Mapping streaming tokens, tool calls, and approval events to UI with cancel and reconnect support

chapters.title: MCP 与 Skills 扩展机制
chapters.summary: 理解协议接入与任务知识封装的区别，实现外部工具连接和 Skills 按需加载
chapters.summaryEn: Protocol integration vs. task knowledge packaging, external tool servers, and on-demand Skills

chapters.title: Agent 评测与轨迹诊断
chapters.summary: 结合最终环境状态和执行轨迹，评估任务成功率、约束遵守、成本与延迟，并定位失败原因
chapters.summaryEn: Evaluating end-state, execution trajectories, constraint adherence, cost, latency, and failure root causes

parts.name: 模块三 · RAG 检索与证据

chapters.title: 文档解析与分块策略
chapters.summary: 将原始文档转为保留结构和来源的检索单元，对比不同分块方式对证据完整性的影响
chapters.summaryEn: Converting raw documents into structure- and source-preserving chunks and comparing splitting strategies

chapters.title: Embedding 与向量检索
chapters.summary: 理解语义向量、相似度与召回边界，跑通索引、查询、元数据过滤和内容更新
chapters.summaryEn: Semantic vectors, similarity metrics, recall boundaries, metadata filtering, and index updates

chapters.title: 混合检索、查询改写与重排
chapters.summary: 组合关键词与向量召回，通过查询改写、RRF 和 Reranker 改善候选证据的覆盖与排序
chapters.summaryEn: Combining BM25 and dense recall with query rewriting, RRF fusion, and Reranker

chapters.title: 引用溯源与证据校验
chapters.summary: 将回答中的论断绑定到来源，识别不受证据支持的内容，并处理证据冲突、不足和拒答
chapters.summaryEn: Grounding claims to sources, detecting unsupported statements, and handling conflicts or abstention

chapters.title: RAG 评测与 Agentic RAG
chapters.summary: 分别评估检索和回答质量，对比固定检索流程与 Agent 自主检索，判断动态检索是否值得引入
chapters.summaryEn: Evaluating retrieval vs. generation quality and comparing fixed pipelines with Agentic RAG
